item.title: 'An eye for an eye': Israel’s death penalty law is retaliatory and electorally motivated
item.summary: The Israeli parliament's adoption of a law establishing "the death penalty for terrorists" – which in practice will only apply to Palestinians – has provoked an international outcry. The reasons for it passing are not just retaliatory, but politically motivated.
